lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: My belly hurts. I want some bread. I need to find something soon.

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: If only Ezra were here to help me... He always knows how to find food.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: If only Ellen could see that I'm here to help her.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: This can't continue like this. Ellen is slowly getting weaker.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: I need to find a way to save them from these monsters.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Who are you? Are you the one the guards have been looking for these days?

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: Lady, don't tell them I'm here, please.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: I'm not telling anyone anything. Who are you, child?

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: I'm Ellen. I have been hiding from those monsters since they took my brother.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: You are indeed the girl they have been looking for.

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: Don't worry, I'm not going to tell them anything, but you have to be silent; they come here often.

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: I'm too scared. Lady, help me.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Woman, come here and get out of the way. We are searching this place from top to bottom.
